Highly recommend to anyone hesitating to go ahead with the big change of their life.

Following Destination Beauty’s public response to my original review, I have updated this review to clarify my full experience and to add important context, including after reviewing my email correspondence.

I waited several months before posting so I could properly heal and reflect. This review reflects my entire end-to-end experience with Destination Beauty, from consultation and decision-making through surgery, recovery, and aftercare.

While the logistics and scheduling were well organised, my overall experience was disappointing. The process often felt rushed and transactional, with limited opportunity for meaningful, unhurried consultation. My concern has never been about a lack of contact, but about the quality, timing, and depth of consultation, particularly with surgeons, and how supported I felt as a person rather than as a case.

For my tummy tuck revision, I had only one consultation with the surgeon. While a nurse assisted with communication, the surgeon’s limited English meant there was no real opportunity for detailed or ongoing discussion about expectations or contouring. While I acknowledge that the surgery was conducted in Thailand, Destination Beauty markets itself primarily to a Western audience. In that context, it is reasonable to expect that adequate systems and support would be in place to ensure clear, effective communication and informed consultation. The outcome,  including residual fat pockets and the need for further revision, reflects this lack of depth.

For my mid-face lift and chin, I met the surgeon for the first time five minutes before being taken into surgery, while already in my gown. At that point, I was told an additional procedure needed to be added to achieve the results I was seeking. This had not been raised earlier and left no genuine opportunity for reflection, a second opinion, or fully informed decision-making.

Concerns were raised while I was still in Thailand, calmly and in good faith. Because of that, I expected a more human, proactive approach to aftercare once I returned home, simple check-ins to see how I was progressing, particularly knowing I was leaving unhappy and still healing. Instead, the responsibility sat entirely with me to initiate contact over the following six months.

After reviewing my email correspondence, I cannot find any instance where I was proactively offered a structured surgical review or follow-up discussion that I declined. While my questions and helpdesk queries were responded to when I reached out, this was largely reactive and procedural. There was no sense of ongoing care, continuity, or relational follow-up. For me, that falls short of what good patient care and customer experience should look like, particularly after concerns had already been raised.

I later required additional liposuction, including micro-suction, because key areas were not adequately addressed initially or during revision. I was also left with chest deformities following gynaecomastia surgery where tissue was removed but not adequately sculpted.

My rating reflects the totality of this experience,  consultation, timing of critical information, outcomes, and aftercare. I share this so future patients understand where they may need to strongly advocate for themselves, and in the hope that a more human, patient-centred approach can be taken in the future.

Unfortunately, I am unhappy with my results and would not return to or recommend Destination Beauty.

When I arrived in Bangkok, everything was well coordinated. Transfers, accommodation, and hospital arrangements were handled seamlessly, which took a huge amount of stress off me and allowed me to focus on preparing for surgery.

The medical team were professional, knowledgeable, and made me feel safe and confident in my decisions. I had multiple procedures done, which is no small thing, but I always felt well looked after. Post-op care has been thorough, with regular check-ins and support throughout recovery.

What really stood out to me was the balance of professionalism and genuine care. You’re not just another number—they actually take the time to make sure you’re okay, both physically and emotionally.

Of course, recovery isn’t easy (no matter where you go), and there are definitely challenging moments—but having a team that supports you through that makes all the difference.

If you’re considering surgery overseas, I would absolutely recommend Destination Beauty. Do your research, ask questions, and be prepared for the recovery journey—but you’ll be in very capable hands.

I am writing to formally express my profound disappointment and serious concerns regarding the services, or rather the lack thereof, provided by Destination Beauty. My commitment to pursuing medical procedures with this organization involved significant international travel from the United States to Thailand. This decision was made based on prior explicit medical clearance from my primary care physician at home and after a comprehensive review of my submitted health metrics, including my precise weight, which were fully communicated and acknowledged by destination beauty team in advance.

Upon my arrival in Thailand, I was unexpectedly informed that my Body Mass Index (BMI) was deemed too high, leading to the unilateral cancellation of my pre-approved procedures. Instead of the agreed-upon treatments, I was offered an entirely different intervention in the form of weight loss surgery. This last-minute reversal, after all pre-travel preparations and expenses had been incurred, represents a significant deviation from our established agreement and previous assurances. The situation was further exacerbated by the notable absence of a direct consultation with the operating surgeon prior to this critical decision, which I consider a fundamental requirement for informed medical consent and responsible practice.

This sequence of events has regrettably given me the strong impression of a misleading change in service provision, undermining the trust I had placed in this organization and rendering my extensive travel commitments purposeless with respect to Destination Beauty.

While I subsequently secured alternative and very professional medical care team with Bangkok Lotus Surgical and Dental Care, my interactions with Destination Beauty have continued to be problematic. Despite my diligent efforts to resolve the financial implications of this cancellation, Destination Beauty has been unduly delaying the processing of my refund, which has now been outstanding for a period exceeding three weeks.

Based on this deeply unsatisfactory experience—encompassing inconsistent pre-approval processes, the abrupt cancellation of agreed-upon procedures, the lack of essential direct medical consultation, and the subsequent prolonged delay in refund processing—I feel it is my responsibility to strongly caution prospective clients regarding the operational practices and professional integrity demonstrated by Destination beauty.
